entities.summary: The Oratorio di San Giorgio or St George's Oratory is a Gothic-style Roman Catholic oratory or prayer hall in Padua, region of Veneto, Italy. It is notable for its frescoed interiors. The oratory is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site Padua's fourteenth-century fresco cycles, inscribed in 2021 for its exceptional example of 14th-century monumental painting.
